set.body: The isolated Security workflow is correctly separated from code Checks but dependency submission cannot complete while GitHub dependency graph is disabled for canardlapin/eyes4s. Acceptance criteria: obtain explicit repository-administration authorization; enable the dependency graph without altering the default GitHub account or unrelated repository settings; rerun Security for a current main SHA; record an exact successful run URL; confirm ordinary Checks remain independently green. Evidence motivating this non-blocking follow-up: source run https://github.com/canardlapin/eyes4s/actions/runs/31897630417 and artifact run https://github.com/canardlapin/eyes4s/actions/runs/31898211357 both generated snapshots successfully and then received HTTP 404 with message that the dependency graph is disabled.
set.title: Enable GitHub dependency graph for isolated Security workflow
